data.gender_notes: Gaetano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Italian name Gaetano, derived from the Late Latin name Gaianus meaning 'God given'. In Christianity, it is the name of several saints. The name Gaetano carries the meaning “God given” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gaetano usually hope their child will grow to embody god given and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's divine guidance and blessing.
data.etymology: Gaetano belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God given.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gaetano total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: גאיטנו
in_hebrew.meaning: גאיטנו נגזר משם איטלקי שפירושו מוקדש לגאית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גאיטנו הוא שינוי של השם האיטלקי 'גאיטאנו', שפירושו מוקדש לגאית. השם נגזר מהשורש הלטיני 'gaudere', שפירושו לשמוח או להיות שמח. השם גאיטנו משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות נוצריות כדי לציין אדם שמקורו או קשור לגאית, ויש לו קונוטציות של שמחה ועליצות.

in_greek.name: Γκαετάνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκαετάνο είναι μια παραλλαγή του ιταλικού ονόματος 'Gaetano', που σημαίνει αφιερωμένος στη χαρά. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τη λατινική λέξη 'gaudere', που σημαίνει να χαίρω ή να είμαι χαρούμενος. Στον Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Γκαετάνο χρησιμοποιείται για να δηλώσει ένα άτομο που συνδέεται με τη χαρά και την ευτυχία, και συχνά συσχετίζεται με την πόλη Gaeta στην Ιταλία.

in_latin.name: Gaetanus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gaetanus derivatur a latino 'gaudere', quod significat gaudens vel beatus. In traditione Christiana, nomen Gaetanus saepe datur in honorem sancti Gaetani, qui fuit presbyter et confessor Christi. Nomen hoc etiam associatur cum urbe Gaeta in Italia, unde origo habet.

in_english.name: Gaetano
in_english.meaning: Gaetano means devoted to joy or from Gaeta
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gaetano is of Italian origin, derived from the Latin word 'gaudere', meaning to rejoice or be glad. It is associated with the town of Gaeta in Italy and has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person devoted to joy and happiness. The name Gaetano has been borne by several saints, including Saint Cajetan, a 16th-century Italian priest and confessor of Christ. In modern times, the name Gaetano is used across various Christian cultures to denote a person of joyful spirit and devotion.

Allegri is best known for his Miserere, a sacred piece for multiple voices which was kept hidden in the Sistine Chapel for over a century due to its extraordinary beauty and complexity.

historical_references.context: Gaetano Donizetti was born in Bergamo and studied at the Bologna Conservatory. He composed his first opera, 'Anna Bolena', in 1830 which was a success and marked the beginning of his career.
